Accordion

Can we start with one team?

Yes. You can start with one team, one site or one critical discipline, and extend the work later with the same method.

How much of our engineers’ time does it take?

A short self-assessment per person, a review by each manager and a limited number of interviews, planned around delivery.

Who sees the individual results?

We agree up front how results are shared and who sees individual data, in line with GDPR. Reports describe teams and roles, not people.

EngagementModel

  1. Scoping

    • A briefing on the roles and skills you need
    • A written proposal with deliverables and timeline

  2. Delivery

    • Work against the agreed milestones
    • Written progress updates

  3. Governance

    • Measures of success agreed at the start
    • Reviews with your decision makers

  4. Follow-up

    • A closing review of the results
    • Recommendations for the next stage

LifecycleSteps

Compact

  1. Map

    Competence mapping

    Know exactly which skills you have, and which you’re missing.

    Explore competence mapping

  2. Develop

    University talent programme

    Grow engineers who are ready from day one.

    Explore the university talent programme

  3. Acquire

    Talent acquisition

    Find and hire the specialists you can’t find alone.

    Explore talent acquisition

  4. Bridge

    Temporary staffing

    Cover peaks, projects and gaps with skilled interim engineers.

    Explore temporary staffing

  5. Secure

    Succession planning

    Make sure every critical role has someone ready to step in.

    Explore succession planning

Expanded

  1. Map

    Competence mapping

    We interview your teams and leads, then map the skills you have against the ones your roadmap needs. You receive a skills matrix, a gap analysis and clear recommendations.

    Explore competence mapping

  2. Develop

    University talent programme

    We select talented university students and train them on the tools and methods your teams use, so they join with the right skillset from the start.

    Explore the university talent programme

  3. Acquire

    Talent acquisition

    Permanent hiring and executive search for technical roles. Every candidate on your shortlist has passed a technical interview run by engineers.

    Explore talent acquisition

  4. Bridge

    Temporary staffing

    Freelance engineers who cover project peaks, leave and hard-to-fill gaps, while you look for the permanent hire.

    Explore temporary staffing

  5. Secure

    Succession planning

    We find your key-person risks, assess who is ready to step up and plan internal or external successors for every critical role.

    Explore succession planning

For HR leaders

  • A clear list of the roles to hire for, and the ones to grow internally.
  • A report you can take to the board.

  • Design teams around the projects on your roadmap.
  • Know which gaps a hire fills and which training closes.

ProcessSteps

  1. 01

    Brief

    We agree the role, the team it joins and what success looks like after a year.

    Typical duration
    1 week

  2. 02

    Search

    We approach engineers who are not looking, as well as those who are.

    Typical duration
    2–3 weeks

  3. 03

    Technical interview

    An engineer from our team tests each candidate on the skills the role needs.

    Typical duration
    1–2 weeks

  4. 04

    Shortlist and offer

    You meet three to five vetted candidates, and we support you up to the signed offer.
